# Cluster declarations in a small package with obvious grouping.
exec gorelo cluster
stdout 'package'
stdout 'Cluster'
stdout 'Modularity'
stdout 'Server'
stdout 'Config'

# JSON output includes modularity and clusters.
exec gorelo cluster --json
stdout '"modularity"'
stdout '"clusters"'
stdout '"package"'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.21
-- server.go --
package main

type Server struct {
	cfg Config
}

func NewServer(c Config) *Server { return &Server{cfg: c} }

func (s *Server) Start() {
	_ = s.cfg
}
-- config.go --
package main

type Config struct {
	Port int
	Host string
}

func DefaultConfig() Config { return Config{Port: 8080, Host: "localhost"} }

func LoadConfig(path string) Config {
	_ = path
	return DefaultConfig()
}
